chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a man who circumambulated the House and became weary: may he delay the tawaf between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until tomorrow? He said: "No."

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two points of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other point of saʿy
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the House, meaning the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: Can someone delay the saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah until the next day after tawaf if he becomes tired?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the rites of hajj or ʿumrah. It indicates that a person who has performed tawaf of the Kaʿbah and then becomes tired should not delay the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until the next day.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2827 - Al-'Ala reported from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who narrated from one of the holy Imams (as) saying: "I asked him about a man who circumambulated the House (Ka'bah) and became weary. Can he delay the Sa'y between Safa and Marwah until the next day?"
